title: RadioGroup

manifest.name: radio-group
manifest.title: RadioGroup
manifest.description: One choice out of several, on Base UI's RadioGroup and Radio: a fieldset of radios named by a FieldLegend, each option in a FieldItem with its own label and description, in three sizes.
manifest.usage: Use RadioGroup when the user must pick exactly one of two to about six options and should see them all at once (TLS mode, line endings). Put it in a Field, a FieldLegend first, then a FieldItem per option with a FieldLabel around a RadioGroupItem and its text, and a FieldDescription when the option needs explaining. With TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field; an empty value means nothing is chosen yet. For more options use Select; for a choice that applies at once in a toolbar, ToggleGroup; for yes/no, Checkbox or Switch.

props.name: value
props.description: Controlled value of the chosen radio.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called when the user chooses another radio.

props.name: size
props.description: Radio size from size.icon.sm, md or lg.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name of the radios' hidden inputs; a Field's name wins.

props.name: required
props.description: A radio must be chosen before the form submits.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Disables every radio; FieldItem's disabled disables one.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: Focusable but the choice cannot change.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes, merged after the component's own.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The group, role="radiogroup", a column with gap space.stack.sm; data-slot="radio-group" and data-size name it.

slots.name: item
slots.description: RadioGroupItem, role="radio"; data-slot="radio-group-item" and data-checked. A hidden <input type="radio"> follows it.

slots.name: indicator
slots.description: The dot, rendered while the radio is chosen.

parts.name: RadioGroupItem
parts.description: One radio, a circle with color.border.strong that fills with the accent solid and a dot in color.accent.fg when chosen.

states.name: hover
states.description: Pointer over a radio: color.interactive.hover, or the accent solid's hover colour when chosen.

states.name: checked
states.description: The chosen radio: the accent solid with a dot.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring.

states.name: invalid
states.description: In an invalid Field: color.status.danger.border borders.

accessibility: Renders a <div role="radiogroup"> named by its FieldLegend (aria-labelledby), with a <span role="radio"> and aria-checked per option, and hidden native inputs for forms.
Tab enters the group at the chosen radio (or the first) and leaves it; arrow keys move the choice, skipping disabled radios.

Wrap each radio and its text in a FieldLabel: the text chooses it too, which enlarges the target beyond the 14 to 20 px circle (WCAG 2.2 target size). A FieldDescription inside the FieldItem describes that option only.
The chosen radio shows a dot as well as the accent fill; the border is color.border.strong (3:1 against the surface).
Focus shows a ring of ring.width in color.ring (3:1 on every surface).
